entries.proposition: Authors' own caveat: the glucosylation state of the N321 glycan was not directly assessed, and the findings are said to support its role among the critical determinants.
entries.snippet: Although we did not directly assess its glucosylation state, these findings support the conclusion that the glycan at position 321, its processing by resident glucosidases and glucosyltransferases and the enhanced engagement of CNX that it promotes, are all critical determinants of NS_PL selection for FAM134B-mediated ERLAD.
